title: Microsoft Classroom: a standalone Microsoft 365 Education app for teaching and learning
summary: The briefing passes: the planned experience, roadmap targets, licensing and Learning Activities controls are supported by Microsoft's sources. Searches confirmed that Classroom-specific availability controls, administrator roles and its arrival default are not yet documented.

claims.quote: Microsoft Classroom is a new, standalone Microsoft 365 experience for teaching and learning

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The Learning Activities switch is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Services > Learning Activities > Turn on Learning Activities.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft 365 admin center (https://admin.microsoft.com), go to Settings > Org settings. In the Services tab, select Learning Activities. In the Learning Activities panel, check or uncheck Turn on Learning Activities.

claims.claim: PATCH /v1.0/servicePrincipals/{id} is the documented Graph operation used to disable Learning Activities through its service principal.
claims.quote: Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/servicePrincipals/$($ServicePrincipal.value.id)" -Method PATCH -Body @{ 'accountEnabled' = $false }

claims.claim: The Learning Activities service principal has AppId 22d27567-b3f0-4dc2-9ec2-46ed368ba538.
claims.quote: $ServicePrincipal = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/servicePrincipals?`$filter=AppId eq '22d27567-b3f0-4dc2-9ec2-46ed368ba538'"

claims.claim: Setting the request-body property accountEnabled to false disables Learning Activities on that service principal.
claims.quote: Admins can disable access for all users in PowerShell. Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/servicePrincipals/$($ServicePrincipal.value.id)" -Method PATCH -Body @{ 'accountEnabled' = $false }
